'''Champion Six''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] from [[Champion Squadron]] who flew a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Prior to the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberation]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Champion Six was patrolling the [[Pyria system]] as the [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] of [[Champion Five]] and [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], flying as [[Rogue Nine/Legends|Rogue Nine]], when they challenged the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Vengeance Derra IV]]'' as it was entering the system. The [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] soon proved itself a part of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s forces when it opened fire on the three starfighters and deployed a small group of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]].

After a short [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]], the cruiser retreated, leaving its entire complement of four TIE fighters and two [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] dead or captured. Champion Six saved Horn's life by killing the TIE fighter that had settled in behind him with a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] as Horn blasted the enemy craft that was pursuing Champion Five.
